papers.title_en: LEDGER: Auditable Agent Memory Under Change
papers.authors: Md Aidul Islam, Md Nasir Uddin Shuvo, Muhammad Waseem, Pekka Abrahamsson
papers.evidence: 可审计智能体记忆层，具事实、来源与删除的显式规则
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆系统多在固定历史上评估，难以应对事实变化、来源可靠性差异和删除请求。本文提出LEDGER记忆层，让语言模型提出事实并用显式规则决定当前值、信任来源和删除操作，LEDGER+EP进一步增加原始对话搜索与删除清理。在编码智能体任务上，LEDGER+EP回退模式正确率达94.3%/91.1%，显著优于完整回放基线；在LongMemEval上以1%上下文实现与完整回放相同的74.8%准确率，验证了可审计高效记忆的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems are mostly evaluated on fixed histories, and only their final answers are scored. In real use, facts change, sources differ in reliability, and users ask the agent to forget things. We present LEDGER, a memory layer in which a language model proposes facts and explicit rules decide which value is current, which source to trust, and what to delete. Each fact keeps its source and the period in which it held. LEDGER+EP adds a search over raw conversation turns for questions the ledger does not cover, and scrubs these turns on deletion. We compare both against no memory, full-history replay, retrieval over raw transcripts, and Mem0, with the same answering model and prompt, on a synthetic multi-session coding-agent workload and a 210-question subset of LongMemEval, and we score both the evidence each memory sends to the model and the answer. On the coding workload, LEDGER+EP in fallback mode answers 94.3% of questions correctly on five development seeds and 91.1% on five held-out seeds, against 82.1% and 83.3% for full replay, the strongest baseline. When a deletion request only describes the fact, no deleted value reached our systems' evidence in any evaluated probe. On LongMemEval, LEDGER+EP in augment mode has the same observed accuracy as full replay (74.8%) with 1% of its context. The main limitation is that the coding workload is synthetic and built by us; on LongMemEval, the differences between the strongest systems are within the confidence intervals.

papers.title_en: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.authors: Aryan Jain, Abhishek Jha, Anish Nediyanchath, Promod Yenigalla
papers.evidence: 双图记忆架构，捕捉长期事件与行为洞察以实现个性化智能体
papers.tldr: 长期记忆对跨长期交互的个性化智能体至关重要，但现有架构只记录事件而不结构化解释其行为原因，导致推理效率低且难迁移。STARK提出双图记忆：情节图记录事件关系，洞察图以事件为边连接行为洞察，推理时直接检索洞察。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上分别提升1.48和0.93分，LongLaMP跨用户迁移提升0.7分。这一事件即边的设计支持跨用户知识迁移和冷启动补救，推动真正学习与记忆。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.

papers.title_en: AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents
papers.authors: Runzhe Wang, Huilin Lu, Shengjie Liu, Li Dong, Zhihuai Zhu
papers.evidence: 面向长程智能体的程序性记忆，含信用分配与生命周期管理
papers.tldr: 现有跨任务记忆代理因缺乏动作级信用分配与存储生命周期，盲目积累经验反而比无记忆代理更差。AdMem让代理在动作前承诺预期结果，并由并行critic评分产生带奖励与反思的程序记忆条目，再通过noisy-OR效用在线更新、检索排序与驱逐合并实现遗忘与巩固。在AgentBoard八个领域共707个任务中，AdMem解决441个，显著超过ReAct的388个和工作流归纳基线的312个。该方法在提供可迁移跨任务结构的领域优势明显，且保持记忆人类可读，便于诊断与审计。
papers.abstract_en: An agent that carries memory across tasks is only as good as the entries it keeps. We begin from an observation that is easy to reproduce and uncomfortable for the field: naively accumulating cross-task experience can make an agent \emph{worse} than one with no memory at all. On AgentBoard, a workflow-induction memory solves fewer tasks than a memoryless ReAct agent in seven of eight domains, and a per-step procedural store with no surrounding structure loses half of ReAct's completions on Jericho. We argue that the missing ingredients are per-action credit assignment and an explicit life cycle for stored entries, and present AdMem, which supplies both. Before each action the actor commits to an expected outcome; a concurrently running critic scores the realized outcome against that expectation and writes a procedural entry carrying a binary reward and a reflection, so credit lands on the action that earned it and no environment reward is required. Each entry then carries a scalar utility, updated online under a noisy-OR reward model, that ranks retrieval jointly with context similarity and drives eviction and merging, giving the store a forgetting and consolidation policy instead of unbounded growth. Across 707 tasks in eight AgentBoard domains AdMem solves 441 against 388 for ReAct and 312 for the workflow-induction baseline --- a pooled gain significant under a two-sided Fisher exact test, concentrated in the domains that supply transferable cross-task structure. All memory stays human-readable text, which is what makes the failures above diagnosable --- and, as we discuss, also makes the store an auditable but attackable surface.

papers.title_en: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
papers.authors: Manan Suri, Dinesh Manocha
papers.evidence: 结合参数整合实现 LLM 智能体的长期记忆
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆系统只靠文本检索，模型权重不更新，跨会话模式难提取且成本高；微调虽改权重但需反向传播且长历史退化。CLAM通过循环超网络单次前向将会话激活流固化为低秩适配器，无梯度无生成调用，并辅以情景缓冲。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上，CLAM领先智能体基线1-45分、梯度方法10-45分，构建时间少3-151倍。该工作首次实现权重空间即时巩固，使参数化记忆固定大小持续累积，为LLM长期记忆提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. A gated latent state carries knowledge across sessions in fixed size, so the parametric memory accumulates without growing. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across three open models (2-7B parameters), CLAM leads all agentic baselines by 1-45 points and all gradient-based parametric methods by 10-45 points, while requiring zero generative LLM calls, zero gradient steps, and 3-151x less wall-clock time than extraction systems to build its memory. The two channels are complementary: the consolidated adapter adds 12-15 accuracy points when the episodic buffer misses the gold evidence, and still adds 4-5 points even with an oracle buffer.

papers.title_en: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
papers.authors: Ruizhe Li, Licheng Zhang, Mingxuan Du, Zhendong Mao
papers.evidence: 使用LLM衍生的决策模型按效用评分检索智能体记忆，替代相似度
papers.tldr: 记忆检索通常依赖相似度，但记忆是否有用取决于世界知识。Jetriever用LLM派生的Jev模型对全池记忆逐条评分效用概率并排序。在InMind上，黄金交换置顶率84.8%、端到端应用76.0%，远超基线；在MemoryAgentBench上平均从44.3%升至55.4%，成本低。该工作将记忆检索从相似度转向效用评估，为智能体记忆系统开辟新方向。
papers.abstract_en: Whether a stored memory helps answer a user's question often depends on world knowledge rather than surface similarity. Jetriever replaces similarity search with full-pool utility scoring: given a query, it uses Jev, an LLM-derived System One decision model, to score every stored memory for the probability that it is useful to the answer, ranking the memory pool directly by those probabilities. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, Jetriever places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases (versus 1.6% for BM25 and 0.0% for MiniLM with user-turn indexing) and reaches 76.0% end-to-end Application, compared with at most 16.0% across published retrieval and memory systems. A controlled 20-question comparison disentangles recognizing implicit evidence from ranking it properly: Jev and Qwen3.5-9B both recover 90% of gold exchanges within the top 50 (versus 30% for the BERT-based decision model Laya), yet at rank 1 Jev reaches 85% while Qwen3.5-9B drops to 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever raises the four-dimension average from 44.3% (ReFind) to 55.4%, at a mean retrieval cost of USD 0.00834 per InMind query and USD 0.03103 per MAB query. Together, these results show that effective utility retrieval hinges on combining broad world knowledge, calibrated ranking probabilities, and affordable full-pool evaluation.

papers.title_en: EvoDisco: Strategy Discovery for Evolving Agent Memory
papers.authors: Mingyang Liu, Qingcan Kang, Shixiong Kai, Kaichao Liang, Xiaojin Fu, Tao Zhong, Linqi Song
papers.evidence: 通过学习的操作符与策略演化智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 大语言模型智能体在交互中积累经验记忆，记忆如何演化与存储内容同样关键，但现有在线更新方法的操作算子和选择规则均固定，缺乏适应性。EvoDisco将记忆演化形式化为演化策略发现任务，通过可学习策略根据当前记忆状态和任务历史动态选择并实例化抽象、精炼、桥接、重构四种语义算子。在ALFWorld、WebShop等多个基准上，EvoDisco显著超越MemP和MemRL，ALFWorld在线提升8.8点、冻结迁移提升12.9点。该方法为智能体记忆的自适应演化提供了新框架，并验证了双层适应度与算子库的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents accumulate experience in memory, and how that memory evolves during interaction is as important as what it stores. Recent methods update memory online, yet both the operators that transform memory and the rules that select them remain fixed by design. We propose EvoDisco, which formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery: the agent must discover which operator to apply, when to apply it, and how to instantiate it, rather than rewriting memory under a static operator schedule. A learnable policy conditions on the current memory state and recent task history, then selects and instantiates one of four semantic operators---Abstract, Refine, Bridge, and Reframe---which respectively compress related memories, decompose overloaded entries, connect weakly linked experiences, and reorganize retrieved reasoning chains. The policy is updated with a bi-level fitness. An inner signal scores each transformation using a retrieval-quality improvement regularized by memory complexity. An outer signal scores strategic efficacy over a window of past decisions, combining historical operator-utility regret, utility-prediction error, and selection diversity. Under a one-pass online plus frozen-transfer protocol on ALFWorld, WebShop, and LifelongAgentBench (OS and DB), EvoDisco improves over strong memory baselines including MemP and MemRL. The largest gains are on ALFWorld ($+8.8$ online / $+12.9$ frozen-transfer points over MemP; $+16.4$ / $+17.9$ over MemRL). Ablations attribute these gains to both fitness levels and the operator library.

papers.title_en: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
papers.authors: Qingcan Kang, Mingyang Liu, Shixiong Kai, Tao Zhong, Mingxuan Yuan
papers.evidence: 解决 LLM 智能体长期记忆中的冲突治理问题
papers.tldr: 长期LLM代理面临存储记忆与变化世界冲突，延迟反馈下难以确定抑制范围是局部还是全局。RegimeCouncil提出轻量路由框架，同时保留局部与全局顾问，通过配对证据或反倾向估计评估记忆效用，并由元治理者按近期效用边际动态仲裁。在多个基准和延迟设置下，RegimeCouncil全面优于最佳固定范围，分歧情节提升5.2-7.3分，聚类转移提升27.9分，开销微秒级。该工作无需重训LLM，为记忆冲突治理提供在线决策方案。
papers.abstract_en: Alongside memory storage and retrieval, a fundamental challenge in long-term LLM agent systems is how the agent should act when stored memories conflict with an evolving world. Facts often go stale without explicit deletion, so the conflict surfaces before the store is refreshed: delayed feedback shows that acting on one outdated record hurt, but not whether suppression should stay on that fact (a local policy) or extend to other stored facts (a global policy). Existing systems hard-code one of these scopes at design time. We formulate this online choice, under hidden validity and delayed feedback, as memory conflict governance, and propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight router that keeps both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them without retraining the LLM. Each memory-assisted response is scored against a no-memory anchor, by off-path paired comparison or by inverse-propensity estimation from the executed action alone. A Local Advisor tracks only the queried fact, a Global Advisor pools recent outcomes across the store, and an asymmetric Meta Governor follows Local by default, switching to Global only when pooling yields a strictly positive recent utility margin. We prove that using delayed outcomes escapes the prompt-only regret floor, that neither fixed scope suffices alone, and that this margin gate switches within bounded time. On LongMemEval streams, historical drift in TempLAMA and TAQA, delays $τ\in [1, 96]$, and sparse or bandit feedback, with Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o, RegimeCouncil outperforms the better fixed scope in all 30 held-out settings, by 5.2-7.3 points on disagreement episodes and +27.9 points over standalone cold-start fallback under clustered shifts, while cutting harmful stale-memory use at microsecond overhead.

papers.title_en: RAG in a Trenchcoat: When Minimal Memory Is Enough for Agentic Systems, and When It Isn't
papers.authors: Jingyu Liu, Zongze Li, Zach Xu, Zhanhui Zhou, Tahseen Rabbani, Dawn Song, Ce Zhang
papers.evidence: 提出极简RAG记忆在智能体记忆基准上达到同等水平
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆研究在RAG上堆叠提取、取代、反思和图谱合成等复杂原语，但作者发现这些在基准上成本与收益不匹配。他们提出极简RAG记忆BRIDGE，仅用链式观察笔记、混合检索和时序渲染，即达到或超越多项基准的SOTA。进一步通过五个对抗性探针发现，不同记忆架构在不同能力上各有胜负，说明现有基准测的是检索而非行动使能。因此主张智能体记忆应评估记忆让代理能做什么，而非仅检索内容。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic memory research has accumulated extraction, supersession, reflection, and graph synthesis on top of retrieval-augmented generation. However, we found that almost none of those primitives earn their cost in our tested memory benchmarks: we show this with BRIDGE, a deliberately minimal RAG memory with chained observation notes, hybrid BM25 with cosine retrieval, and chronological rendering, which reaches parity within bootstrap CI with the prior SOTA on LongMemEval-S and BEAM, and beats the best memory baseline on EverMemBench by 5.7-6.3 points at matched reader. It runs at ~5-7K reader-prompt tokens per query, using a single LLM call for each ingestion or query. We argue that this parity is itself the result: standard benchmarks score what memory retrieves, not what memory enables when the agent acts. To test the latter, we introduce five adversarial probes (Rule Application +-, Pattern Induction Style / Procedural, Dynamic Multiturn) judged at generation time by a cross vendor verification chain, where each query can only be solved by applying a remembered rule or pattern it never mentions. Across 5 probes x 20 scenarios, no architecture wins universally: atomic fact extractors (LangMem) win rule application, while BRIDGE's block-summary memory wins pattern induction. This result holds across four domains, three graders, and three reader families. Each design fails where the other wins, for reasons a recall benchmark cannot see: atomic-fact extractors discard the form a demonstrated pattern takes, while block-summary memory retrieves the rule but the reader does not act on it, a gap that presenting the rule more prominently largely closes. What separates memory designs is not what they retrieve but what they enable an agent to do, and that is what agentic memory should be evaluated on.

papers.title_en: Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Hejia Zhang, Zhongming Yu, Yimin Ding, Wei-Ting Chen, Hengjia Yu, Wentao Ni, Yijun Liu, Cong Xu, Xin Chen, Matrix Yao, Fan Zhao, Jishen Zhao
papers.evidence: 基准测试LLM智能体中的多智能体记忆不一致性
papers.tldr: 多智能体委派虽提高了证据检索覆盖率，却导致事实冲突在交接中丢失。本研究构建基准与证据流分析器，在 Harvey LAB 文档审查中注入受控冲突。委派使检索对立主张从50.2%升至68.7%，但冲突检测率从16.2%降至13.2%，仅35.2%的对被完整上报。工人到领导的交接是提升冲突检测的关键环节。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent delegation lets LLM systems distribute evidence collection across workers with separate contexts. This creates a consistency challenge: facts retrieved by workers may be missing from the evidence available to the lead for a joint conclusion. We introduce a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for studying multi-agent memory inconsistency through controlled factual conflicts in Harvey LAB document-review tasks. Pooled across three models with comparable generation spending, requiring delegation increases retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7% relative to single-agent execution, yet conflict detection falls from 16.2% to 13.2%. Within this setting, workers report both claims for only 35.2% of retrieved pairs, and pooled matched comparisons show higher detection than single-agent execution when one worker reads both claims but lower detection when the claims are split across workers. Worker-to-lead handoffs are a central target for improving conflict detection in multi-agent LLMs.

papers.title_en: Beyond Episodic Recall: Experience-to-Knowledge Evolution for Lifelong Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: Weitao An, Chenghao Xu, Xu Yang, Cheng Deng
papers.evidence: 双时间尺度记忆框架将经验演化为知识
papers.tldr: 终身具身导航要求智能体复用累积经验，但现有方法存储成本高且未将经验显式演化为环境知识。EvoNav提出双时间尺度记忆框架，以稀疏经验原子组织语义、空间与反馈线索，并在慢时间尺度蒸馏出环境特定结构知识。在单目标、顺序多楼层和多模态导航中，EvoNav以紧凑持久记忆实现有效经验复用与路径效率提升。该方法成功迁移至真实机器人，为终身导航提供经验到知识演化的新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong embodied navigation requires agents to accumulate experience through continuous interaction and reuse it for subsequent goal searches. Existing memory-enhanced methods typically retain historical observations or construct structured scene representations. However, storing observations or high-dimensional semantic embeddings incurs growing storage costs. Meanwhile, structured representations support retrieval and semantic reasoning but do not explicitly evolve accumulated experience into environment-specific knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose Experience-Evolving Memory (EvoNav), a novel two-timescale memory framework. It organizes semantic observations, spatial relations, and task-feedback cues into sparse experience atoms. During online operation, experience atoms continually consolidate repeated observations and form dynamic links based on transitions. At the slower timescale, EvoNav distills accumulated category co-occurrences and feedback signals into environment-specific structural knowledge without relying on predefined object--room relations. For each new goal, EvoNav combines direct goal evidence from experience atoms with learned structural knowledge to guide goal-directed search on the current traversability map. Experiments on single-goal, sequential multi-floor, and multimodal navigation demonstrate effective experience reuse and improved path efficiency with compact persistent memory, together with successful transfer to a real robot.

papers.title_en: LMMR: Learned Multigranular Memory Retrieval for Small Language Model Agents
papers.authors: Pengfeng Song, Yunkai Zhuang, Liye Shi
papers.evidence: 小语言模型智能体的多粒度记忆检索方法
papers.tldr: 小语言模型代理回答多跳问题时受限于内存空间，相关事实常散落在多个记录中且被冗余文本包围。LMMR提出多粒度记忆检索，同时决定读取哪个来源及其粒度，通过将段落和句子片段链接到原出处并在训练中配对互补视图，利用干扰项和重复信息构建对比示例。推理时重排序器评估候选对锚点的信息增量，选择器在token预算内精选证据。在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA和MuSiQue上，2B模型在400 token预算下F1达61.47、43.26、30.58，较查询扩展提升3-4.6点，且输入token减少23-27%。该方法显著提升小模型多跳推理的效率和准确性。
papers.abstract_en: Small language model agents have limited space to read the memory needed for multi-hop questions. Relevant facts are often scattered across records whose surrounding text consumes much of that space. We propose LMMR, a learned multigranular memory retrieval method that selects both the next source and how much of it to read. LMMR links paragraphs and sentence fragments to their original sources and pairs views that supply the same missing support during training. Relevant distractors and repeated information provide contrasting examples. At inference, the reranker scores what each candidate adds to an anchor passage, and a selector chooses the evidence within a token budget. On 22,398 official validation questions from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue, a frozen 2B answer model reaches 61.47, 43.26, and 30.58 F1 under a 400-token budget. The gains over query expansion are 3.06, 2.14, and 4.55 points, while memory input decreases by 23.1-26.9%. LMMR also uses 23.5-27.7% fewer input tokens than a coarse retriever trained on the same questions. Against that retriever followed by LLMLingua-2 at comparable input lengths, F1 gains reach 3.99 points and are significant on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA after Holm correction. All eight small answer models evaluated on HotpotQA improve over query expansion and MMR in both F1 and exact match.

papers.title_en: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
papers.authors: Jiangyun Zhang, Zhou Tang, Kristen Surrao, Zhiyu Chen, Albert Guan, Tor Nitayanont, Yupei Zhang, Roopali Singh, Yunkai Xiao, Shreya Pandit, Julia Huang, Shayan Ali Akbar, Erwin Cornejo, Yuan Li, Yi Zhang
papers.evidence: 企业智能体的自进化记忆架构
papers.tldr: 企业LLM智能体需应对动态环境及准确率与成本双重约束。ARISE通过迭代自评估让记忆从失败中演化，归因失败并生成可检索微记忆和宏观规则，仅在留出集准确率提升时更新。在14个企业工作流上，ARISE-Teacher分别提升10.9和5.8个百分点，超过GEPA。该架构无需改模型权重或工具，减少4.0%模型调用和5.2%输出令牌，实现成本高效自进化。
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent's memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and $τ^2$-bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on $τ^2$-bench. ARISE-Teacher also outperforms GEPA by 4.5 pp on $τ^2$-bench and 1.4 pp on SOP-Bench. With the deployment model as its own attributor, ARISE-Self still gains 10.0 pp on SOP-Bench. ARISE-Teacher uses 4.0% fewer model calls and 5.2% fewer output tokens at comparable per-task cost (-1.0%).

papers.title_en: MemoSync: Co-Managing Developer-Agent Metamemory Across Contexts
papers.authors: Baiqiao Zhang, Junze Li, Chunyang Luo, Yuying Tang, Wenshuo Zhang, Shiyuan Piao, Dingdong Liu, Shuai Ma, Xiaojuan Ma
papers.evidence: AI编码智能体的元记忆协同管理
papers.tldr: AI编程代理在项目间自动存储和检索上下文，但开发者难以监控和控制其记忆行为，导致元记忆错位。MemoSync将代理记忆变为共享可操作表示，让代理提议记忆候选并报告使用情况，开发者可审查、编辑和限定范围。在132人对照研究中，MemoSync显著提升任务表现和记忆对齐度，且不增加感知负荷。该系统为开发者与代理的记忆共同管理提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents increasingly manage what context carries across sessions and projects, but developers have limited visibility into what these agents store, retrieve, and apply. This opacity creates a metamemory problem: the developer's meta-level judgments about what should be remembered are separated from the agent's object-level memory operations, disrupting the monitoring and control that keep the two levels aligned. We conducted a formative study with 12 developers and identified what they want to monitor and control across four dimensions of agent memory use. Based on these findings, we designed MemoSync, a co-management system that treats agent memory as a shared, operable representation: the agent proposes memory candidates and reports which items it uses, and the developer reviews, edits, and scopes them. In a between-subjects study (N=132) against two baselines, MemoSync participants achieved significantly higher task performance and the highest mean developer-agent memory alignment. In an exploratory mediation analysis, the alignment advantage was primarily driven by improved monitoring accuracy. Despite performing substantially more monitoring and control actions, participants reported no increase in perceived workload. A week-long deployment with nine developers showed that memory monitoring and control fit into everyday development work. MemoSync is open-sourced at https://github.com/SLEEPYBQ/MemoSync.

papers.title_en: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
papers.authors: Siqi Xiang, Zhipeng Xu, Shengrui Liu, Zulong Chen, Chunyan Miao, Shijian Lu
papers.evidence: 以视觉分辨率作为注意力分配的记忆感知机制用于智能体交互历史
papers.tldr: 针对LLM智能体在长时任务中积累大量交互历史、现有记忆管理忽视感知粒度的问题，提出分辨率即注意力机制RAA，将过往交互渲染为图像并动态调整分辨率以分配注意力。实验表明RAA在不影响任务性能的情况下减少超过50%的token消耗，并可即插即用与现有方法集成，进一步节省token，揭示自适应感知是记忆管理的互补维度。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.

papers.title_en: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.authors: Ziyan Yang, Taiwei Shi, Jieyu Zhao
papers.evidence: 长程LLM智能体的无损无索引记忆机制
papers.tldr: 长时程LLM智能体常因上下文窗口限制丢弃后续可能需要的细节，现有内存管理采用有损压缩或结构化检索。GrepMem提出仅用追加纯文本日志和正则表达式搜索实现无损、无索引记忆。在ContextBench等多任务中准确率达95-97%，远超有损基线（最高21%），并在BCP-Multi上超SUPO摘要8.8个百分点。结果表明纯文本日志加grep即可提供简单且具竞争力的长时程记忆方案，无需复杂基础设施。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents often exceed their context windows, forcing them to discard information that may be needed later. Existing context management strategies rely on summarization, masking, or structured memory, requiring decisions about what to preserve or how to retrieve it before future needs are known. However, these methods can introduce lossy compression, potentially discarding details needed for future tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce GrepMem, a simple, lossless, and index-free memory mechanism built on two components: an append-only plain-text log of the agent's complete history and a regular-expression search tool for on-demand recall. Unlike structured memory systems, GrepMem requires no embeddings, retrieval index, memory extraction, or additional models. We train Qwen3.5-9B with reinforcement learning under five context management strategies and evaluate on multi-question research sessions, long-stream recall, and agent-trajectory question answering. GrepMem achieves 95-97% accuracy on ContextBench, versus at most 21% for lossy baselines, and outperforms SUPO's summarization by 8.8 percentage points on BCP-Multi. GrepMem scales effectively to increasingly long input streams while remaining on the accuracy-token-cost Pareto frontier across all five evaluation tasks. Our results show that a plain-text log and grep provide a simple but competitive approach to long-horizon agent memory, without requiring complex structured memory infrastructure.

papers.title_en: DriftGuard: Online Memory-Drift Detection via Causal Attribution for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Licheng Pan, Yuzhou Chen, Zhixuan Chu, Yichen Sun, Han Zheng, Zhiyu Wang, Hao Wang, Yan Wang, Bingyu Zhu, Haiwen Hong, Longtao Huang, Kui Ren
papers.evidence: 在线检测记忆漂移，估计每条检索记忆的因果贡献
papers.tldr: LLM智能体依赖持久记忆，易受记忆漂移攻击；现有特征无法因果归因且反事实分析成本高。DriftGuard采用两阶段框架：离线通过成对反事实重放构造因果监督并聚合为记忆漂移分数MDS；在线学习风险模型仅用动作前信息估计MDS。实验表明其能准确识别漂移诱导记忆，支持高效在线防御，提升智能体可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on persistent memory to plan tool calls and complete multi-step tasks, which exposes them to memory drift: an adversarial or misleading memory alters the execution path and final outcome. In this work, we investigate online memory-drift detection, which estimates each retrieved memory's causal contribution to potential drift at serving time. We identify two fundamental challenges. (1) Content-level features are insufficient for causal memory-drift attribution, as perplexity or retrieval relevance alone cannot determine which retrieved memory would change agent behavior if neutralized; (2) Counterfactual attribution is prohibitively expensive for online detection, as it requires replaying downstream agent and tool execution for each candidate memory, exceeding real-time serving budgets. To address these challenges, we propose DriftGuard, a two-stage framework that decouples offline causal supervision from online estimation. Specifically, DriftGuard first constructs causal supervision through repeated paired counterfactual replays, continuing the original and single-memory neutralized trajectory suffixes from a shared pre-action state. The resulting annotations are aggregated by component-wise majority voting into a memory drift score (MDS) that captures action change, attack removal, violation removal, and task recovery. Guided by this supervision, DriftGuard then learns an online risk model that estimates MDS from pre-action information and flags drift-inducing memories via its maximum component risk, without online counterfactual rollouts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DriftGuard accurately identifies drift-inducing memories and enables efficient online defense. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DriftGuard-7F0B.

papers.title_en: HabitusMem: Belief Memory over Evolving User Preferences for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yifan Lu, Gaoyang Guo, Wen Chen, Ziyun Zou, Jian Wu, Han Zhu, Imran Razzak
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的用户偏好信念记忆
papers.tldr: 个性化LLM智能体需适应用户动态偏好，但现有记忆系统仅存储历史内容，无法判断偏好是否仍有效或适用范围，导致过时或误用。HabitusMem将记忆视为智能体对用户的信念，把用户偏好建模为潜在状态，通过交互更新，训练写入器生成带证据、范围和状态的文本记录。在PersonaMem-v2和VitaBench 2.0上，该方法在两个智能体家族中取得最佳结果；请求条件学习驱动回答增益，辅助训练改善工具使用。该机制提升了智能体对演化偏好的适应能力。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized LLM agents must act on a user's current preferences, which change across interactions and are rarely stated in full. Existing memory systems store and retrieve content from the interaction history and leave the agent to work out which preferences still hold and where they apply. Such content does not indicate whether a preference is still current or where it applies, so agents often act on outdated or misapplied preferences. We instead treat memory as the assistant's belief about the user. Following Bourdieu's account of habitus as durable but revisable dispositions, we model the user as a latent preference state that every interaction, including the current request, both reveals and updates. The belief summarizes what the history supports about this state, and memory consists of the individual beliefs that bear on the agent's current decision, each with its evidence, scope, and status. We implement this view in HabitusMem, a trained writer that states these beliefs as text records for a frozen agent. Across two agent families, HabitusMem achieves the best results among memory systems on both PersonaMem-v2 and VitaBench 2.0. Controlled analyses show that learned request conditioning drives the answering gain, while auxiliary training tasks improve tool use.

papers.title_en: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
papers.authors: Yutong Guan, Meixing Shi, Haoran Sun, Bing Sun, Yuxiang Cai, Yankai Jiang
papers.evidence: 为长视频智能体提出时间索引的分层记忆
papers.tldr: 现有长视频记忆检索依赖全局语义匹配，缺乏状态驱动的时间控制，常返回碎片化或冗余证据，难以维持连贯证据链。EvoMem构建分层时间索引记忆，引入自进化检索技能，将时间线索转化为显式约束，动态调整检索内容、记忆操作和时间范围。在四个长视频问答基准上，EvoMem平均准确率达60.1%，较此前最佳方法平均提升8.6个百分点。该方法通过奖励引导的技能进化实现过程级引导，无需更新模型参数即显著提升长视频推理能力。
papers.abstract_en: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

papers.title_en: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
papers.authors: K. R. Jayaram, Vatche Isahagian, Aswath Vaithinathan Aravindan, Vinod Muthusamy, Punleuk Oum, Gaodan Fang, Michal Ulewicz, Gegi Thomas, Evelyn Duesterwald
papers.evidence: LLM智能体从自身历史中自蒸馏记忆的流水线
papers.tldr: LLM智能体在长程任务中反复出现程序性错误，缺乏从自身历史学习的能力。本文提出一种自蒸馏记忆流水线：从智能体轨迹挖掘经验教训，再整合为带支持度计数的指南，推理时提供全部或精选子集。在AppWorld基准上，强模型DeepSeek-V3.2使用全部191条指南提升9.5个任务完成点，而弱模型gpt-oss-120b在约29条精选子集下表现最佳。该工作揭示了记忆量是模型属性而非记忆本身，并总结了部署经验。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. The central finding is that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory. A strong model keeps improving as guidelines are added. DeepSeek-V3.2 gains +9.5 points of task completion and +16.1 points of scenario completion with its full 191-guideline set. A weak model gains less from the same full set than from a small selected subset. gpt-oss-120b starts at 39.9\% task completion. It reaches 51.2\% with all 199 of its guidelines but 55.4\% (mean of two runs) with a selected subset of about 29. Around that result we report what went wrong: a high-support guideline that backfired, provenance silently dropped during consolidation, a swallowed API error that failed every task while producing a plausible log, and a baseline confound that nearly produced a misleading comparison with a prior method. We distill these into recommendations for teams deploying agent memory.

papers.title_en: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
papers.authors: Xuyang Liu, Chenwen Lu, Junxi Wang, Siyu Ren, Xinying Lin, Siteng Huang, Hongli Sun, Linfeng Zhang, Honggang Chen
papers.evidence: 结构引导的记忆折叠用于高效智能体记忆管理
papers.tldr: 长期智能体记忆存储不断膨胀，导致检索与生成开销剧增，现有剪枝或合并方法各有缺陷。MemFolder提出结构引导的记忆折叠框架，通过RecordFolder利用实体锚点合并兼容记录，ContextFolder验证反馈压缩组内文本，依次减少记录数与上下文长度。在LoCoMo等三个文本基准上，RecordFolder在减少50%记录时保留99.0%性能，超最强基线1.9个百分点。该框架可与现有压缩方法结合，进一步提升记忆效率，为高效agent记忆管理提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

papers.title_en: Privacy Protection in Self-Evolving Personal Agents: Persistent Memory and Cross-Carrier Transfer
papers.authors: Zibin Lin, Taotao Wang, Shengli Zhang
papers.evidence: 个人智能体中的持久记忆及隐私保护
papers.tldr: 该文针对自我进化个人智能体中持久记忆带来的隐私问题，梳理记忆的准入、维护、释放和撤回机制，并通过预订、反馈学习和撤回等场景验证。调查揭示提示修订与记忆读取的构成关系，以及宽泛标签保护和删除对效用的影响。诊断实验测量了隐私保护措施的成本，指出记忆谱系缺失会掩盖衍生状态，为构建隐私安全的智能体记忆系统提供了原则参考。
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents carry private experience into later decisions through persistent memory. This thematic survey compares memory admission, maintenance, release, and withdrawal by protected change, observer, and validation setting. Direct evidence in the screened corpus comes from controlled memory workflows. Three worked scenarios follow one private fact through booking, feedback-driven learning, and withdrawal. We show when prompt revision and memory reads compose, when skills inherit a private head's bound, and why reader non-use does not establish cleanup of learned state. Diagnostic experiments measure the utility costs of wider label protection and broad memory deletion, and test how missing lineage obscures descendants.

papers.title_en: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
papers.authors: Huanran Li, Nhat X. T. Le, Kevin De Angeli, Yao Xuan, Alireza Vahdatpour, Djordje Gligorijevic
papers.evidence: 为LLM智能体调优异构模型提供多阶段跨会话记忆
papers.tldr: 针对LLM智能体调参缺乏跨会话记忆导致重复试验、且异构模型经验难以复用的问题，Engram提出多阶段记忆系统：在线阶段在初始指导、会话检索和候选审查等决策点提供经过验证的经验证据，离线阶段提炼教训实现记忆自我改进。在两个广告模型上，Engram仅用基线53%的试验次数达到其32次试验结果，且平均最终模型更优。该框架大幅提升异构模型调参效率，并实现经验的可复用积累。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.

papers.title_en: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
papers.authors: Xinyu Cao, Tianjie Ju, Zhuosheng Zhang
papers.evidence: 为智能体记忆和技能开发视觉程序，演化记忆以保留视觉证据用于延迟查询
papers.tldr: 针对多模态代理在延迟查询场景下难以保留关键视觉证据的问题，提出EvoViM框架。该框架将模型自身交互经验递归转化为一个用于记忆和技能的视觉程序，程序直接对像素操作并决定证据使用。在记忆进化时，模型追踪视觉轨迹中的失败，定位并修订丢失或误用证据的操作，同时重写辅助笔记和分析工具。在六个任务上，EvoViM较最强基线AutoMem平均提升三十一点三至四十七点六分，证明交互经验对塑造视觉证据保留具有关键价值。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.

papers.title_en: ContextFact: Remembering Facts in Context for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Jiayu Huang, Yichao Cai, Xinyu Li, Zhen Zhang, Javen Qinfeng Shi
papers.evidence: 为长期对话设计记忆构建与检索，保留事实及其上下文
papers.tldr: 针对长期对话代理中事实分散、检索缺乏上下文的问题，研究记忆构建与检索单元边界对可答性和证据访问的影响，发现仅靠检索选择无法解决上下文缺失。提出相邻轮次分组方法，在相同独有轮次预算下提升证据访问效率，为长期对话记忆设计提供指导。
papers.abstract_en: Agents built on large language models must maintain continuity across repeated interactions with users. However, long-term conversations scatter facts across turns and sessions, making it difficult to retrieve the right evidence with enough context. Memory for such conversations must therefore preserve facts with their context while keeping evidence selectively accessible. We first study how memory construction and retrieval-unit boundaries affect answerability and evidence access. Reading the entire memory bank reveals gaps that cannot be resolved by retrieval selection alone, showing that some context must be preserved during memory construction. Adjacent-turn grouping improves evidence access at matched unique-turn budgets, while wider windows do not consistently help. This motivates keeping fact-specific context local while organizing cross-session evidence separately. We propose ContextFact, which links context-preserving fact memories with source-grounded entity representations. Within sessions, it gathers the context needed to interpret each fact. Across sessions, it aligns recurring referents and revisits the source dialogue to reconstruct coherent entity representations linked to the supporting facts. At query time, ContextFact retrieves fact and entity views, reranks them independently, and uses entity-linked expansion to surface related facts; complete entity representations then provide organized cross-session evidence. With Qwen3.5-27B as the backbone, ContextFact achieves state-of-the-art performance while using only $21\%$ of the evidence tokens consumed by the strongest evaluated baseline, obtaining $86.49\%$ overall judge accuracy on LoCoMo and $91.00\%$ on LongMemEval-S. Controlled ablations support context-preserving fact boundaries and source-grounded entity reconstruction, while entity readout improves multi-hop accuracy beyond adding more facts.

papers.title_en: Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents
papers.authors: Grigorii Davydenko, Artem Sakhno, Igor Pavlov, Julia Belikova, Andrey Savchenko, Maksim Makarenko
papers.evidence: 组合蒸馏的记忆写入与检索策略用于长期网络助手
papers.tldr: 针对长期Web助手需要有效记忆与检索机制但独立训练的策略能否组合的问题，研究通过策略蒸馏将记忆写入和顺序检索策略分别蒸馏到3B模型并与固定答案生成器组合，无需联合优化。在LongMemEval基准上，组合系统达到73.1%准确率，远超36.2%的基线，证明独立蒸馏策略可有效组合，为低成本构建长期智能体记忆提供途径。
papers.abstract_en: Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition, highlighting the importance of cross-specialist compatibility. Further task-specific adaptation improves accuracy to 75.2% on LongMemEval through RL and 48.9% on PersonaMem-v2 through supervised distillation. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of independent specialist distillation for modular multi-agent systems. Source code and datasets of teacher-generated memory-editing and retrieval trajectories are released to facilitate reproducibility and further research.

papers.title_en: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
papers.authors: Yuxuan Chen, Changwei Lv, Yunfei Li, Zhongjing Du, Kehui Tan, Zijun Liao, Ruochong Zheng, Hao Chen, Can Deng, Zheni Zeng, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
papers.evidence: 任务感知的多模态经验整合用于自我改进智能体
papers.tldr: 该文针对智能体在长期交互中积累多模态记录但缺乏从完成任务中学习、经验难以复用的问题，提出任务感知的多模态记忆框架MMMem。MMMem通过源链接多视图记忆组织文本、图像和渲染页面，并结合互补策略提取和整合任务特定经验。实验表明该方法使智能体能够在新问题上利用整合后的经验，减少重复错误，为多模态智能体的长期记忆与自我改进提供了有效机制。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

papers.title_en: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting with Physics-Indexed Specialist Memory: the Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent
papers.authors: Blas Eugenio Vicco Zarate, Miguel Hernán Vicco
papers.evidence: 进化专家策略作为持续强化学习的可重用记忆
papers.tldr: 针对持续强化学习中的灾难性遗忘，提出进化神经可塑智能体，通过环境检测归档专家策略，并以贝叶斯策略复用检索记忆。在非平稳 CartPole 和 HalfCheetah 环境中，完整架构在 30 次重复实验中平均成功率达 83.2%。该方法为智能体提供可重用的物理索引记忆，推动持续学习中的记忆系统设计。
papers.abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning requires adaptation to changing conditions while preserving performance under previously encountered dynamics. It was investigated whether specialists generated by evolutionary search can provide a reusable memory when combined with environment detection and failure-driven search. The Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent (ENA) evolves small neural networks without gradients, archives selected policies by detected dynamic regime, and retrieves them through Bayesian policy reuse. The architecture was evaluated in non-stationary CartPole and HalfCheetah environments. In the 30-replicate CartPole ablation, the complete architecture achieved a mean success rate of 83.2% across the five test environments. Among variants that learned the harder CartPole environments, the complete architecture showed the most consistent retention. A selection ablation also showed that the retrieval rule affected performance. In the evaluated sequences, ENA adapted more slowly than PPO on CartPole and achieved lower returns than SAC on HalfCheetah. The evidence concerns the complete architecture and does not isolate gradient-free optimization as the cause of retention or establish superiority over other continual-learning methods.

papers.title_en: Perception into Imagination: Executable Memory for World Models
papers.authors: Xianyao Li, Ruitong Tian, Rui Min, Fang Xu, Jing Du
papers.evidence: 物理智能体世界模型的可执行感知记忆
papers.tldr: 针对物理智能体在感知丢失后使用记忆的需求，提出可执行感知记忆框架，在想象过程中推进显式感知状态，在Memory Maze任务上显著提升回报。
papers.abstract_en: Physical agents must use what they previously saw or touched after visibility or contact is lost. Their actions change the implications of these remembered facts. We introduce executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination. Its evolving read-out informs reward prediction, value estimation and policy learning. We align reward inputs with the transitions that produced them and supervise the reward head on open-loop rollouts of recorded actions. On Memory Maze $13\times13$, EPM reaches 30.37 return at 1M interactions, compared with 23.37 when the same evolving read-out informs only policy and value on a common perceptual front end: a gain of 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]. The complete method also improves control on $9\times9$ and in MiniWorld. Probes of remembered, out-of-view arrivals show stronger reward anticipation in both visual implementations. Concentration, tactile recovery and real tactile frames demonstrate complementary roles of remembered facts in imagined-policy training, motion-dependent decisions and sensory-content retention. EPM connects persistent perception to the predicted consequences and learning signals of a world model for Physical AI.

papers.title_en: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
papers.authors: Minghe Zhang, Xuetao Kang, Yifei Ming, Yanfei Chen, Han Yu, Yufan Zhuang, Chen-Yu Lee
papers.evidence: 记忆是智能体可编辑组件的一部分，解决记忆膨胀问题
papers.tldr: 本文针对自主智能体在无外部评分时递归自改进易导致局部回归、技能遗忘和记忆膨胀的问题，提出GUARD框架，通过将任务分解为执行前自检并利用方向性遗憾引导可编辑组件更新，实现无需参考的持续进化。实验表明该方法能稳定自我改进并减少记忆膨胀。该框架为AI智能体记忆系统的鲁棒更新提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes an edit only when gains outweigh regressions, scoping specialized fixes to prevent over-triggering and guaranteeing non-regression on its gated buffer. At test time, one frozen harness runs in a single pass. Across benchmarks on memory, skill evolution, continual task streams, and domain reasoning, GUARD consistently improves performance without catastrophic forgetting or memory pollution while substantially cutting deployment token usage.

papers.title_en: CompAct-Bench: A Benchmark for Working-Context Compaction in Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
papers.authors: Jiayi Chen, Lizhe Chen, Yujia Chen, Shihan Dou, Ming Zhang, Chendi Ge, Shiguang Ni, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Maxm Pan
papers.evidence: 长周期智能体任务中工作上下文压缩的基准
papers.tldr: 该文针对长周期智能体任务中工作上下文不断积累、压缩能力缺乏系统评估的问题，提出基准CompAct-Bench。该基准从成功智能体轨迹中插入压缩边界，压缩先前上下文后让同一执行器继续任务，通过下游任务完成率评估压缩效果。实验揭示了现代LLM在工作上下文压缩上的能力差异，为智能体记忆压缩方法提供了标准化评测工具。
papers.abstract_en: As language-model agents are applied to increasingly extended tasks, their working context continuously accumulates interaction history, tool observations, intermediate decisions, and task progress. Context compaction offers a practical way to reduce this growing history while allowing execution to continue, yet the compaction ability of modern LLMs remains insufficiently understood. We introduce CompAct-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating working-context compaction through its downstream effect on agent task completion. Starting from successful agent trajectories, we insert compaction boundaries at different stages of execution, compress the preceding working context with the model under evaluation, and let the same executor continue the original task. To enable fair comparison across compactors, we evaluate them under controlled retention ratios using a lightweight iterative ratio-adjustment procedure. CompAct-Bench covers information-seeking, software-engineering, and workspace-oriented tasks through BrowseComp, SWE-bench, and an internal CompanyBench evaluation. Our experiments show that working-context compaction remains highly lossy even for frontier models: Claude- and GPT-family models perform strongest overall, yet substantial degradation in downstream task accuracy persists under aggressive compaction. Further analysis reveals that failures are often caused not only by omitted information, but also by distorted task state, such as turning unresolved issues into apparent conclusions or forgetting previously established results, which can lead to incorrect decisions or redundant execution. These findings highlight working-context compaction as a distinct and still challenging ability for LLMs operating in extended agent tasks.

papers.title_en: Mem-X: A Memory-Dependent Cross-Episode Benchmark for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Zhikang Shi, Yuk Tung Samuel Fang, Hongyu Ding, Zixuan Chen, Yujin Wang, Junhui Guo, You Wu, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao
papers.evidence: 视觉语言导航中依赖记忆的跨情景基准
papers.tldr: 针对现有跨情景视觉语言导航基准难以判断导航是否真正依赖记忆的问题，Mem-X将情景组织成会话，让后续指令引用先前遇到的对象或路线。该基准包含三个层次：历史对象回忆、记忆内定位与情节索引、以及记忆外重定位与历史路线复现。实验表明Mem-X能清晰区分基于长期记忆和纯探索的导航行为。该工作为记忆依赖导航提供了有效评估工具。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables embodied agents to reuse past observations across tasks. However, existing cross-episode vision-and-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks often leave it unclear whether successful navigation relies on historical memory or current exploration. We introduce Mem-X, a benchmark designed to evaluate memory-dependent cross-episode VLN. Mem-X organizes episodes into sessions in which subsequent instructions refer to objects or routes encountered in earlier episodes. Its three levels evaluate historical-object recall, in-memory localization and episodic indexing, and off-memory relocalization and historical-route reproduction. For the latter two levels, agents receive episode-local poses but no transformations between episode frames, requiring them to establish spatial correspondence with historical memory. Mem-X comprises 2,071 episodes across 710 sessions in 34 scenes, including 1,204 memory-dependent episodes. We also provide MemBridge, a modular baseline that combines semantic scene memory, cross-episode localization, and coarse-to-fine retrieval to support existing VLN agents. Experiments with state-of-the-art VLN methods demonstrate the benefits of MemBridge while revealing substantial room for improvement on memory-dependent navigation. The benchmark and baseline code are available at https://github.com/NJU-R-L-Group-Embodied-Lab/Mem-X.

papers.title_en: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Changin Choi, Jungwon Park, Jungmin Ko, Jimyeong Kim, Wonjong Rhee
papers.evidence: 长视频问答智能体的结构化视频记忆与记忆技能
papers.tldr: 该文针对长视频问答中智能体难以确定搜索内容、选择记忆源和连接远距离证据的问题，提出视频记忆技能智能体VMSA。VMSA联合设计结构化视频记忆与记忆技能，构建片段描述记忆、实体事件记忆等互补组件，以支持可搜索的检索和跨时间推理。实验表明该框架有效提升了长视频理解中的证据检索和问答性能，为视频智能体的记忆设计提供了范例。
papers.abstract_en: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. To further support effective memory utilization, VMSA induces memory skills from successful agent trajectories, incrementally refining or extending a compact skill library to guide iterative evidence retrieval, reasoning, and verification. Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of all three memory components and memory skills, with memory skills also improving temporal evidence localization.

papers.title_en: Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
papers.authors: Suleman Khan, Rasa Rahnema, Tara Khani, Majid Fekri, Fattane Zarrinkalam
papers.evidence: 在需要隐式回忆的真实工作场景任务上评估记忆智能体
papers.tldr: 针对现有记忆基准测试基于问答且显式提示召回，与实际工作场景的隐式记忆需求不匹配的问题，论文在 DolphinBench 上评估 Memanto。Memanto 利用信息论相关性分数排序记忆，在 600 个模拟工作场所任务（每个均验证需记忆）中完成 503 个（83.83%），优于基准配置的 70.67%。结果凸显隐式记忆评估的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Memory benchmarks built on question answering tell an agent which fact to recall. Workplace requests often leave that need implicit: to post an update in the team's channel, an agent must work out which channel from earlier interactions and use it in a tool call. We evaluate Memanto, a memory agent that ranks memories with an information-theoretic relevance score, on DolphinBench, which tests memory through 600 simulated workplace tasks, each validated as requiring memory. Running in the Hermes agent harness with GPT-6-Luna and at most 6 iterations per conversation, Memanto completes 503 tasks (83.83%). The strongest configuration reported by the benchmark's authors, Mem0 with GPT-5.6-Luna and up to 60 iterations, completes 424 (70.67%). Memanto's run also has the lowest total cost ($10.86, against $61.48 for the cheapest reported run) and the shortest median task latency (15.32s). Grading uses the benchmark's own judge, but the agent model differs, so these results compare complete systems. The memory system affects both whether an agent completes such tasks and what completion costs.

papers.title_en: Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking: Memory-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: Weile Gong, Zijian Lu, Jiahao Zheng, Bo Xu, Yiping Zuo, Jiajia Guo, Xin He, Weijun Wang, Weibei Fan
papers.evidence: 利用保留视觉上下文实现具身导航智能体的记忆引导自适应推理
papers.tldr: 该文针对具身导航中频繁推理带来的计算成本问题，提出认知视野动作分块框架CHAC，利用保留的视觉上下文、完成线索和控制器反馈动态决定认知视野，缓存路点以减少模型调用。在HM3D-OVON和R2R-CE上分别降低33.4%和64.7%的视觉-语言模型调用，成功率下降仅为0.63和10.82个百分点。该方法展示了记忆引导的推理调度在资源受限导航智能体中的有效性，为高效智能体设计提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models are advancing embodied navigation, but frequent inference incurs substantial computational cost. We present Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking (CHAC), a training-free framework for memory-guided adaptive reasoning with a frozen navigation policy. Retained visual context, completion cues, and controller feedback determine the cognitive horizon, or how many cached waypoints the robot executes before refreshing its prediction. At the policy's stop request, local visitation history guides a bounded correction with at most one extra movement and no additional model calls. CHAC reduces vision-language model calls by 33.4% on HM3D-OVON and 64.7% on R2R-CE, with success-rate decreases of 0.63 and 10.82 percentage points, respectively. Success rate and success weighted by path length improve per model call on both benchmarks. Across four physical navigation tasks with 40 runs per method, CHAC achieves 18 successes versus 14 for native execution, reducing model calls by 54.9% and GPU inference time by 49.7%.

papers.title_en: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu, Songlin Liu, Yiqing Hu, Caifeng Shan
papers.evidence: 大语言模型的可扩展记忆架构
papers.tldr: 部署在长程和持续交互中的大语言模型需要可复用的记忆状态，但标准Transformer的KV缓存导致内存和计算开销线性增长，线性时间架构则丢失细节。MemOnce提出一种基础架构，仅缓存少数最后层隐藏状态作为紧凑记忆表示，并动态解码以恢复信息。该设计旨在结合Transformer的细节保留和线性架构的固定状态优势。实验验证了其可扩展性。MemOnce为智能体提供了一种模型级记忆基础，支撑长期上下文处理。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.

papers.title_en: Cache the Knowledge, Not Just the Prompt: Dynamic Datalog as the Action Language for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Bruno Rucy Carneiro Alves de Lima, Victor Henrique Cabral Pinheiro
papers.evidence: 动态Datalog REPL作为LLM智能体会话记忆
papers.tldr: 针对LLM智能体在知识图谱问答中每次从头计算程序的问题，本文提出使用动态Datalog REPL作为会话状态。智能体可以在会话中插入、撤回规则，派生事实保持最新，同时利用提示缓存复用模型处理。在三个知识图谱的问题链上，智能体在179/180个案例中复用了REPL保持的关系，相比于SQL或Python方案写入更少输出token。该工作为LLM智能体提供了高效的知识持久化机制，有潜力作为专用领域的记忆层。
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent that answers questions about a knowledge graph writes a program per question, and its tools evaluate each from scratch. We give the agent a Datalog REPL, a session over a dynamic Datalog engine, in which rules are inserted and retracted like facts while derived facts stay current. Prompt caching reuses the model's processing of what a session shares, and the Datalog REPL reuses the evaluation of it. On chains of questions over three knowledge graphs, agents reuse a relation that the REPL keeps in 179 of 180 cases, with two models, and write fewer output tokens: SQL and Python agents write 23 to 82% more. With SQL tables or a Python namespace, Claude Haiku 5.5 stores almost nothing for later questions, and a chain of seven questions at 13 million facts takes it a median of 48 and 56 s, against 31 s with the REPL. Claude Opus 5.5 matches the REPL by storing tables in SQL, and when the data changes it stores views, which are evaluated again at every read. A relation that the REPL keeps is read like a table and stays current like a view. Datalog is a niche language beside SQL and Python, and with thinking enabled the models answer as accurately with it.

papers.title_en: Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving
papers.authors: Colin Hong, Bryan Shan, Wei Siong Pang, Chengzhi Lu, Xu Guo, Nitin Shivaraman, Tao Luo, Esha Choukse, Kisson Lin, Dmitrii Ustiugov
papers.evidence: 运行时管理智能体上下文与KV缓存驱逐，与记忆基础设施相关
papers.tldr: 针对LLM智能体服务中不断增长的执行历史导致KV缓存压力大、吞吐受限的问题，提出Contexture架构，分离完整对话历史与模型执行上下文，基于工具操作追溯识别可移除token，实现运行时上下文驱逐。实验表明可识别64%的最终历史token为移除候选，显著提升高吞吐服务性能，为智能体高效记忆管理提供支撑。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents such as Hermes, OpenClaw, and Codex repeatedly resend growing execution histories, increasing shared GPU key-value (KV) cache demand in high-bandwidth memory (HBM). We show that shared KV capacity limits agent-serving throughput. Existing context-reduction methods lack global cache-state visibility, while runtime KV managers lack tool-execution information. Tracing tokens to their originating tool operations reveals that later operations supersede earlier outputs and associated turns, identifying 64% of recorded final-history tokens as removal candidates.   We present Contexture, a harness- and model-agnostic architecture for runtime context eviction. Contexture separates the harness's full conversation history from the model's execution context, reducing subsequent requests' KV demand without modifying harness logic or model execution. It combines tool-execution information with global visibility into shared KV pressure and prefix residency: supersession identifies removal candidates, while runtime state determines when removal justifies sacrificing cached computation. This coordination reduces memory demand and decode KV traffic while limiting re-prefill interference with concurrent decoding, without additional model calls or training. Across two models, two harnesses, and two benchmarks, Contexture improves throughput under SLO by 20-73% over the best of no eviction, harness compaction, AgentDiet, and Continuum, and by 7-63% over observation masking in five of eight configurations, and reduces GPU energy per completed session by up to 11%. It also raises throughput under SLO by 23% over LMCache alone on H100. Live-agent experiments show a mean accuracy improvement of 1.4 percentage points over unloaded no eviction, with a worst-case loss of 3.7 points, while observation masking loses 3-28 points.
